note: ib_dam_wysiwyg (submodule of ib_dam) is DEPRECATED (removed in 6.0.0). It provides one text-format filter id ib_dam_wysiwyg (TYPE_MARKUP_LANGUAGE) whose process() now returns the text UNCHANGED and triggers an E_USER_DEPRECATED notice; hook_requirements adds a runtime deprecation warning. Its migration hook ib_dam_wysiwyg_update_9000 removes the filter from all formats and converts legacy inline IB JSON markup into <drupal-media> tags. No config, no schema, no permissions. Enablement state lives in filter.format.<id> -> filters.ib_dam_wysiwyg.status. Cases grounded in the filter plugin and the filter.format config. Glue/deprecated submodule: 3 easy / 1 medium / 1 hard.

evals.prompt: Is the ib_dam_wysiwyg module still functional, and what does its text filter do to field content in the current release?
evals.expected_output: It is deprecated (removed in 6.0.0). Its filter's process() now returns the text unchanged and triggers an E_USER_DEPRECATED notice; the module also raises a runtime 'deprecated' requirement warning. Use ib_dam_media instead.

evals.prompt: What is the plugin id and filter type of the text-format filter provided by the ib_dam_wysiwyg module?
evals.expected_output: The filter plugin id is ib_dam_wysiwyg (title 'IntelligenceBank DAM WYSIWYG'), of type TYPE_MARKUP_LANGUAGE.

evals.prompt: What does the ib_dam_wysiwyg update hook (ib_dam_wysiwyg_update_9000) do to legacy IntelligenceBank content?
evals.expected_output: ib_dam_wysiwyg_update_9000() removes the ib_dam_wysiwyg filter from all text formats and converts legacy inline IB custom-JSON markup in text fields into standard <drupal-media> tags, creating real media entities (via ib_dam_media's MediaStorage / MediaTypeMatcher).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the deprecated ib_dam_wysiwyg filter is enabled on exactly one text format. Inspect the live filter format configuration and give the machine name of that format.
evals.expected_output: filter.format.ibw_probe_fmt has filters.ib_dam_wysiwyg.status = true, so the deprecated ib_dam_wysiwyg filter is enabled on the ibw_probe_fmt format.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create a text format with machine name ibw_build_fmt (label 'IBW Build') and enable the ib_dam_wysiwyg filter on it, applying the change to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: A filter.format.ibw_build_fmt config entity exists with filters.ib_dam_wysiwyg.status = true (e.g. FilterFormat::create then setFilterConfig('ib_dam_wysiwyg', ['status' => TRUE])->save()).
